title: EdgeNet Observation
description: The signed, versioned wire unit gossiped across the EdgeNet mesh (ADR-0004). One node's report of one target. Carries only a coarse obsCell, never raw observer coordinates (ADR-0007). The canonical bytes signed are this object minus `sig`, JSON-serialized with recursively sorted keys; the reference implementation is src/mesh/observation.js.

v.description: Schema version. Gates evolution; receivers ignore (do not crash on) unknown future versions.

target.description: Stable target id within the kind: icao24 | norad | sensor-id.

az.description: Target azimuth in the observer frame, degrees [0, 360].

el.description: Target elevation in the observer frame, degrees [-90, 90].

range_m.description: Slant range in metres, if known. Often absent for passive bearing-only receivers (MLAT recovers position downstream).

obsCell.description: COARSE observer location as a geohash (≈±2.4 km at precision 5). NEVER raw lat/lon — privacy is enforced by the wire format (ADR-0007).

payload.description: Kind-specific extras (callsign, alt_m, rssi, §13 embedding ref, ...). The format's extensibility point.

nodeId.description: Self-certifying pseudonymous identity: the node's Ed25519 public key as pk:<base58>. Receivers verify `sig` directly from this — no key distribution (ADR-0004).

sig.description: base64 Ed25519 signature over the canonical bytes (this object minus `sig`).
